reported_failure_modes: Instruction and Description are hardest classes (small, variably formatted)
over-detection in densely packed answer sections (multiple boxes around same answer block)

sources.title: VLM-FO1: Bridging the Gap Between High-Level Reasoning and Fine-Grained Perception in VLMs

facts.key_quote: This failure stems from a fundamental mismatch, as generating exact numerical coordinates is a challenging task for language-centric architectures.
facts.approach: reframes object-centric perception from brittle coordinate generation into robust feature retrieval; HFRE dual vision encoder + token-based referencing

used_for: Q4 核心机制性证据

sources.title: InspectVLM: Unified in Theory, Unreliable in Practice

facts.key_quote: the model exhibits brittle behavior under low prompt variability, produces degenerate outputs for fine-grained object detection, and frequently defaults to memorized language responses regardless of visual input.

used_for: Q4 失败模式：格式不稳 / 退化输出 / 幻觉

sources.title: Getting to the Point: Pointing Improves LVLMs at Counting

facts.key_result: Point-then-Count: predicted points correctly grounded in more than 94% of cases (F1-score); gains arise from spatial information encoded in predicted coordinates
facts.caveat: task is zero-shot counting on natural scenes, NOT document layout

used_for: Q4 社区缓解手段（坐标降级为点）

sources.title: Qwen-VL 系列坐标体系的变化解惑 | The Ever-Changing Coordinate System Has Been Confusing Me (issue #1485)

facts.key_quote_zh: 从 Qwen2-VL 到 Qwen2.5-VL，再到 Qwen3-VL，坐标体系经历了从 0-1000 到 绝对坐标，又回到 0-1000 的变化。在最新的 Qwen3-VL 演示案例中，模型在思考过程中展示的是绝对坐标，而最终生成的动作却又是 0-1000 的范围。

used_for: Q4 坐标系契约不稳定的官方仓库证据
sources.uncertainty: issue 为社区提问，非官方规范；官方未在该 issue 正文中给出答复
